top_violation_types.title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1601)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operations classrooms are out of ratio at times.

top_violation_types.title: Mounting of Fire Extinguishers (26 TAC §747.5105)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The fire extinguisher was not mounted.

top_violation_types.title: Child/Caregiver Ratio - Licensed Child Care Home (26 TAC §747.1801)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: A total of one caregiver and ten children were observed inside the licensed childcare home. The maximum children allowed is seven children based on their age group. The licensed childcare home is out of ratio by three children.

top_violation_types.title: Children's Records - Health Statement (26 TAC §747.603(a)(3))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: One child is missing a health statement.

top_violation_types.title: Documentation of Training Requirements-Original Training Certification Card or Letter in each Employee's Personnel record (26 TAC §747.1327(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Three caregivers did not have any annual training certificates or documentation to review annual training hours completed by the caregivers.

top_violation_types.title: Infant May Not Sleep in a Restrictive Device (26 TAC §747.2326(a)(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The primary caregiver stated that one of the infants has been sleeping in a swing instead of a play yard. This was corrected during the inspection when the primary caregiver was informed that infants cannot sleep in swings without a sleep expection form signed by a doctor.

top_violation_types.title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §747.3501)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: A propane tank was observed in an outdoor area accessible to children.

top_violation_types.title: AP Initial background checks submitted - At the time a non-client resident 14 or older moves into your home or operation (26 TAC §745.621(a)(5))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: It was determined that the primary caregiver did not submit a background check for a household member.
